# Quarterly Hardscape and Fountain Maintenance Log
Riverbend Corporate Park - Facilities Maintenance Division
Date: 04/14/2026
Lead Technician: Neil Delgado | Supervisor: Raymond Haddad

## Site Asset Inventory
| Feature | Location | Material / Equipment | Specification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| North Courtyard Fountain | Zone 1 Plaza | Cast stone tier basin, 450 gal | Submersible pump, cartridge filter |
| Executive Walkway | Zone 2 Access | Flagstone paver path (1,800 sq ft) | Polymeric sand joints |
| South Visitor Lot | Zone 4 Parking | Asphalt paving (42,000 sq ft) | Type II slurry seal, extruded curbs |
| East Terrace Planters | Zone 3 Deck | Precast concrete beds (8 units) | Integral weep holes, PVC liners |

## Scheduled Service Tasks
- Flagstone walkway: Clean out degraded joint material and sweep fresh polymeric sand into paver joints.
- Asphalt lot: Inspect perimeter curbing and fill linear cracks over 1/4 in with hot-pour rubberized sealant.
- Terrace planters: Clear root debris from interior drainage weep holes and verify unobstructed discharge.
- Tier basin fountain: Drain 450 gal reservoir, brush algae from cast stone surfaces, and descale nozzle manifold.

## Safety and Chemical Controls
- Wear safety goggles and heavy chemical gloves when handling sodium hypochlorite or muriatic descaler.
- Apply hot-pour asphalt crack sealant only when surface temperatures exceed 40 °F and dry conditions prevail.

## Work Sign-Off Notes
Technician Nadia Kim completed crack sealing along 320 linear ft of asphalt curb lines in Zone 4. Pressure washing of the Zone 1 cast stone fountain basin was completed using a 0-degree red tip at 4,000 psi to remove mineral crusting. Polymeric sand application on the Zone 2 flagstone walkway was completed by sweeping sand into dry joints. Pump filter cartridge in Zone 1 inspected, flushed, and reseated.

errors.quote: fountain basin was completed using a 0-degree red tip at 4,000 psi to remove mineral crusting
errors.explanation: A 0-degree red spray tip produces an intense, pinpoint stream at 4,000 psi that damages and etches cast stone; industry practice requires wide fan tips (25-degree green or 40-degree white) and lower pressure (under 1,500 psi) on architectural cast stone.
errors.fix: fountain basin was completed using a 40-degree white tip at 1,200 psi to remove mineral crusting

errors.quote: Polymeric sand application on the Zone 2 flagstone walkway was completed by sweeping sand into dry joints.
errors.explanation: Polymeric sand installation requires watering (mist activation) after sweeping to activate the polymer binders; sweeping dry sand into joints without subsequent water activation leaves the joints unbonded and prone to washing out.
errors.fix: Polymeric sand application on the Zone 2 flagstone walkway was completed by sweeping sand into dry joints and lightly misting with water to activate binder.
